help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Online: choose Make a Payment, then One-Time Payment to pay from checking or savings in two steps, or Automatic Payments to enroll in Pennymac AutoPay in three steps. You can also call (800) 777-4001 to use the free 24-hour automated phone system or talk with a representative.

By mail, make the check payable to Pennymac and include your loan number; use the closest address: PO Box 30597, Los Angeles CA 90030-0597; P.O. Box 660929, Dallas TX 75266-0929; or P.O. Box 4095, Carol Stream IL 60197-4095. Western Union Quick Collect is also accepted (Western Union charges its own fee). Money transfer apps are not accepted.

help.title: Cancel or change an AutoPay draft
paragraphs: You can cancel a draft or change its date or amount in your account as long as you do it at least three business days before the next scheduled draft.
A draft that is scheduled for today cannot be cancelled or stopped.
steps: Open Pending Payments or your AutoPay settings.
Cancel the draft or change its date or amount.

help.title: PennyPaperless
paragraphs: Go paperless to view, print or save your Monthly and Year-End Statements online at any time.
steps: Open Account Settings and choose Paperless Preferences.
Select Online Only for your Monthly and/or Year-End Statements.

help.title: When is a payment late?
paragraphs: Payments are normally due on the 1st, with a 15-day grace period. A payment received after the grace period, typically after the 16th of the month, is late and a late fee is applied. Your billing statement shows your grace period and late fee amount.

The late charge follows your Note, loan type and applicable law. A returned payment (non-sufficient funds) costs up to $18.50. Paying with the automated pay-by-phone service and requesting a payoff statement are free.
You can schedule a One-Time Payment up to 60 days ahead in your online account so it arrives on time.

help.title: Relief and assistance
paragraphs: If you are struggling, Pennymac relief programs include loan modifications and government-funded assistance, plus disaster help. If you cannot keep the home, a short sale or deed in lieu of foreclosure may be possible.

Pennymac does not charge a fee for a modification or other loss mitigation plan when you are behind. Call the relief team at (866) 545-9070; free HUD-approved counseling is available at (800) 569-4287.
